Courchevel

The top of Les 3 Vallées, with its own altiport.

Plan a trip to Courchevel

In short

Courchevel at a glance.

Courchevel is a set of villages at the top of Les 3 Vallées, one of the largest linked ski areas in the world, which also includes Méribel and Val Thorens.

Region
Savoie, France
Ski area
Les 3 Vallées
Nearest airports
Geneva or Lyon (about 2.5 hours), Chambéry (about 1.5 hours); the altiport for small aircraft and helicopters
Best for
Big-mileage skiing, chalets, fine dining

Who Courchevel is for

Skiers who want a different valley every day, and groups who want a chalet with a chef.

When to go to Courchevel

Winter, usually from December to April.

How to get to Courchevel

By car from Geneva or Lyon in about two and a half hours, or by train to Moûtiers and then about 40 minutes by road. Helicopter and small-plane transfers land at the altiport.

Where to stay

Where to stay in Courchevel.

We arrange hotels and chalets in Courchevel on request. Tell us what you need and we suggest the right one for your group.
